mapper.select: select authority_id, authority_name, authority_key, parent_id, order_num, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from authorities where status = '0' order by order_num asc, authority_id asc

select distinct a.authority_key from sys_user_role ur join auth_role rr on rr.role_id = ur.role_id join authorities a on a.authority_id = rr.authority_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and a.status = '0' and a.authority_key is not null and a.authority_key != '' union select distinct a.authority_key from sys_user u join sys_role r on r.role_key = u.user_type join auth_role rr on rr.role_id = r.role_id join authorities a on a.authority_id = rr.authority_id where u.user_id = #{userId} and a.status = '0' and a.authority_key is not null and a.authority_key != ''
